name: comp-586
blurb: Centered search navbar with voice input and auth buttons.
description: Header with logo on left, centered search bar with voice button, community link and sign-in/start buttons on right. Theme toggle included.
use_when: Search-first interfaces (apps, content discovery) with optional voice input.
avoid_when: Content-heavy navigation or tight horizontal space.
a11y: Search input labeled. Voice button has aria-label. Auth links are semantic. Theme toggle keyboard-accessible.
